rationale.R1: Remove preceding3 SMART-derived bases only when adapter is detected; paired read-through overlap supports this. No unconditional R1 trimming.
rationale.R2: Manufacturer first3 removal plus3prime adapter removal.
rationale.overlap: Require10 overlap positions to reduce chance matches with R1 leading wildcards.
rationale.length: Both cleaned reads must be at least the index k-mer length31; retain count of all removed pairs.
rationale.none_added: No quality, polyG, rRNA removal, deduplication or outcome-informed filtering.

manifest_contract.raw_expected_pairs: ENA count; full original compressed size/MD5/SHA verified
manifest_contract.preprocessing_config_sha256: Same canonical config hash all28; required per-run field
manifest_contract.input_output_integrity: SHA256/bytes of both cleaned FASTQs and Cutadapt JSON; input cleanup only after verified native outputs
manifest_contract.old_pilot: Move kit-only initial full output, manifest and log under diagnostics before restarting; never skipped as corrected
manifest_contract.point_estimator: Same Salmon2.8 hash/index/bias options/ISR auto detection;10threads, zero bootstraps

qc_note: 20% transcript mapping is a review trigger; assay-specific total-RNA/exonic evidence requires an outcome-blind QC amendment by statistics owner. Endpoint/memberships/tests unchanged.
QC_review_policy: All28 retained. Transcript mapping below20% is a reported review flag, not an automatic exclusion after this outcome-blind total-RNA/rRNA/adapter review. Raw/retained counts, strand/EM success, checksums and one immutable preprocessing hash remain mandatory; downstream owner amends exact gate before scoring.
